en.headline: Lydia Sham wins Hong Kong's first Asian Games gold in wushu
en.dek: The flag bearer scored 9.713 in the women's changquan final in Nagoya, 0.003 ahead of Macao's Sou Cho-man, as teammate Michelle Yeung finished fifth.
body: Hong Kong wushu athlete Lydia Sham Hui-yu won the women's changquan final at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Monday, delivering the city's first gold medal of the Games.

Sham, one of Hong Kong's two flag bearers at Saturday's opening ceremony, scored 9.713 at the Aichi Prefectural Martial Arts Hall. Macao's Sou Cho-man took silver with 9.710 and Indonesia's Eugenia Diva Widodo bronze with 9.706. Sixteen athletes contested the final. Hong Kong teammate Michelle Yeung placed fifth on 9.703.

It is Sham's third Asian Games. She has previously won the women's changquan-jianshu-qiangshu all-around at the 2025 World Games in Chengdu and the women's changquan title at the World Wushu Championships. She said after the final that eight years of preparation across three Games had come down to about a minute and a half on the floor, and that focusing on a single event had given her more time to refine individual movements.

Under the Jockey Club's outstanding athlete award scheme, the gold carries a cash incentive of HK$1 million. Hong Kong's medal tally at these Games now stands at one gold and two silvers. The Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games run until 4 October.

zh.headline: 沈曉榆女子長拳奪金 港隊亞運第一金
zh.dek: 開幕禮持旗手沈曉榆在名古屋以9.713分奪得女子長拳金牌，僅高澳門選手0.003分，隊友楊子瑩排第五。
body: 香港武術代表沈曉榆周一在愛知—名古屋亞運會女子長拳決賽奪冠，為港隊贏得本屆亞運第一面金牌。
沈曉榆是周六開幕禮港隊兩名持旗手之一，在愛知縣立武道館交出9.713分。澳門選手蘇楚雯以9.710分獲銀牌，印尼選手尤金尼娅·迪娃·維多多以9.706分獲銅牌。決賽共16人競逐。另一名港將楊子瑩取得9.703分，排名第五。
這是沈曉榆第三次出戰亞運。她曾在2025年成都世界運動會奪得女子長拳、劍術及槍術全能金牌，並在世界武術錦標賽女子長拳稱霸。她賽後表示，三屆亞運前後八年，最終只得一分半鐘在台上發揮，今次改為專攻長拳，有更多時間打磨細節動作。
根據賽馬會優秀運動員獎勵計劃，此金牌可獲港幣100萬元獎金。港隊現時在本屆亞運的獎牌為一金兩銀。愛知—名古屋亞運會舉行至10月4日。
